claims.statement: For Apps using third-party services, the source recommends unique service login/password credentials, no shared service accounts across Apps and infrastructure admin access limited to employees with administrative duties. Preserve conditional service scope and employee/staffing assumptions; credential uniqueness and role intent require profile review rather than universal password-only or employer requirements.

Organization owners manage owned App settings by default and may delegate developer-setting access through App-manager permissions. App managers cannot manage third-party applications. Owned-registration management differs from installation control, user authorization and effective repository access.

App logging/monitoring is advisory; suggested events include authentication/authorization, configuration, object access, permission changes and admin elevation. Logs should consistently timestamp events and identify users/IPs/hosts. Examples are not a mandate to collect all personal data; retention, privacy and effective observation need separate policy review.
